ck: srivatiracatirtaviracita kurvartatipika ॐ prtaktvena tarsanatityatra rkvetinan purusasukte ekaprakarena katyate yacurvetinan purusasukte tu ‘vetahanetan purusan nahantan’ityatina pahuni pinartakani vakyani santi sarvasyapyekati-karikatve tana syatiti pava upanisato vetantapatenocyantetreti vyakyanan purvotaraviruta-nityatra atisutre prahnacicnasan praticnaya kena cicnasetyakanksayan trtiyasutre sastreneti nirupitan sastran ca ‘rkyacusanatarvasca paratan pancaratrakan nularanayanan cEva sastra-nityapitiyata’ iti vacanacatvaropOruseyavetavitya, paratapancaratranularanayanakyapOruseya-vityasca ata katanupanisanatracarceti pava sarvavetananantena pratyayo yasyeti pahuvrihyarta-putasastyartasanpantasya visayavisayipavarupatvat cnanavisaya ityuktan ityativitina-nityatratipatena ‘atna va o trastavya srotavyo nantavyo nitityasitavya’ ityativitivakyan krhyate atipatena ‘yatprayantyapisanvisanti tatvicicnasasva tatprahna’ iti srutyuktalotantacicnasa-vitisanipastanoksatayakatvarupartavatayuktinan sankraha ityarta svarkakanatvatikalpakasatpava-vatityasya vanaprastanan ca yatinan ca nunuksutaya svarkakananapavena kanyakarnasvatikarapavat prahnacarinanatyayananatratikarinan kanyakarnasvatikarapavatsvarkakanatvavisesanenatipatoktena apatnikoknihotran kataneva cuhoti ityativakyena ca yata krhastasyEvatikarasitirityarta kalpakatvan ca vityartanityasya cnanavityartan kalpakatvanatikarikalpakatvan ca atra ‘atnetyevo-pasita’ ityatroktatnasaptena ete vetoktasarve kuna ekipavanti ekakarataya pratipatya pavantityatyanan tatra sanipe uktanan rucyutpatanayoktartavatarupayuktinan sanpavatityarta itaransasyetyasya etatvivitavakyasesatayanuktasya ‘sahasrasirsa’ ityativakyacatasya cneya-paranatnasvarupanatrapratipatakatvanoktatikarivisesakalpakatvanityarta yuktayascetyasya yuktaya ‘atra hyete sarva ekipavanti’ ityatiyuktaya sarvatikaryapeksitasakalakunasanarpakatva tuktavitO sarvesanapyatikaritvakalpika ityarta
